RETAIL-FIRST ENTRY AND CHANNEL EXPANSION | G4-G6
+-- Launched / expanded in 2023
|   +-- [S] Q1: Intuit POS migration partnership; thousands adopted.
|   +-- [S] Aug: $89/month Retail Plan for physical-first businesses.
|   `-- [S] Q3: 16% of Retail Pro location growth came from this plan.
+-- Reacceleration: Q3 2026
|   +-- [S] 55% of merchants adding POS were new to Shopify.
|   +-- [S] Large, complex, multi-location merchants grew fastest.
|   +-- [S] Their total locations on Shopify increased 52% YoY.
|   +-- [S] Offline GMV grew 30% YoY.
|   `-- [S] Local-currency subscription billing added in 10 countries.
+-- Entry -[claim]-> broader platform adoption
|   [S] Q2 2026 Arhaus example: online -> offline, B2B, Payments.
|   [I] One expansion example does not quantify the average path.
+-- Denominators matter
    [I] New-to-Shopify does not mean newly founded.
    [I] Merchant counts, locations and GMV are different measures.
    [I] 55% is a quarterly entry mix, not annual mix or revenue share.
